record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo (Toxel 1 star, Toxtricity 2 stars, passive NONE) declare OVERDRIVE in this production reference. Shared strategy; only the star count and stats differ.
record.summary: SPECIAL damage to every enemy within radius 3 of the cast target, EXCLUDING the target's own cell (includesCenter is false), so the cast target itself is not hit. The raw amount per victim is the caster's current attack x (M - 0.2 x (d - 1)), where M = 1.2 for 1 and 2 stars (1.5 at 3 stars, 3 at 4 or more) and d is the Chebyshev distance from the CASTER to the victim's cell (not from the target). Nearer victims take more; the amount is not rounded before handleSpecialDamage. No status, heal or shield.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy only provides the centre of the area; it is not hit
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: area around the target's cell, centre cell excluded; Board.getCellsInRadius turns radius 3 into 3.5 and includes cells with dx^2 + dy^2 < 12.25 that are on the board; only enemy-occupied cells are hit; damage falls off with the caster's Chebyshev distance to each victim

declaredRaw.unit: multiplier M of the caster's current atk (before the distance term)

effects.scaling: requested amount = pokemon.atk (current value at the cast, so atk buffs apply) x (M - 0.2 x (d - 1)) with d the Chebyshev distance caster -> victim. Illustration only (arithmetic, not a fight): Toxtricity catalog atk 20, M 1.2: d = 1 -> 24, d = 2 -> 20, d = 3 -> 16, d = 4 -> 12. AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true, explicit); a cast crit multiplies by critPower reduced by each victim's critReductionFactor (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false). The multiplier term can reach zero or below for d >= 7 (M 1.2), which is not reachable inside a radius-3 area around an adjacent target on the stated board, but this was not checked against board dimensions.
effects.resolution: applied per victim: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x speDef) with speDef halved if the victim has armor reduction active, ceil, minimum 1, shield first; takenDamage is not used by this ability. A victim with protect / skydiving / magicBounce takes 0 (magicBounce may reflect SPECIAL damage unless the caster holds Protective Pads); a dead or resurrecting victim takes 0. Requested amount (atk x term x AP x crit) differs from the applied HP loss.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the 3 and 4 star multipliers (1.5, 3; fallback 3) are not reachable by the two listed units. maxPP 90 and range 1 for both; catalog atk is 8 (Toxel) and 20 (Toxtricity).

record.positionalConditions: Victims must be enemies inside the radius-3 area around the cast target excluding the target's cell; the falloff depends on the caster's distance to each victim.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared: multiplier 1.2 (1 and 2 stars) of the caster's current atk, minus 0.2 per cell of Chebyshev distance beyond 1 from the caster. The result is a non-rounded requested SPECIAL amount; it is then scaled by AP (and crit) and divided by 1 + 0.05 x speDef (ceil, at least 1). The cast target is not a victim.
